value.rationale: The natural closure of the full Kneser disjointness relation has a sharp all-parameter maximum Horn premise witness number and an exceptional giant lattice symmetry group at n=2k. These facts quantify implication explanation complexity and distinguish relational symmetries from concept-lattice symmetries; the exact modular/distributive and reconstruction boundaries complete the structural classification. It is motivated by symmetric concept lattices and logical closure, not a handpicked subfamily. The same integer n-2k+2 as Kneser chromatic number is identified without claiming a new coloring proof.
